decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - ?	A schedule for all new windows, doors and architrave at scale 1:20 be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Authority before the commence of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 3 - ?	Full details of the following:
a)	roof tiles
b)	ridge tiles
be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Authority before the commence of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 4 - Sample panels of brickwork showing the proposed colour, texture, face-bond and pointing shall be provided on site and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the works are commenced and the sample panels shall be retained on site until the work is completed and has been approved.
Condition : 5 - No plumbing or pipes, other than rainwater pipes, shall be fixed on the external faces of the building unless shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until there has been  submitted and approved by the Local Planning Authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment erected.

Condition : 7 - No development shall take place until full details of both the hard and soft landscaping works around the vicinity of the Listed Buildings and the new property  have been submitted and approved by the Local Planning Authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.  These details shall include finished levels, hard surfacing, materials, minor artefacts, lighting, furniture and refuse.
description: Erection of two storey detached building comprising 2 self contained flats and a self contained carer's unit.
